basic_info.description: Exquisite top level, two story condo with gorgeous panoramic views. Stunning architectural details with all the modern amenities. The Main level foyer has gallery walls that lead into the beautiful living room with views of the bay, Alcatraz & beyond. Fantastic kitchen w butler's pantry, Wolf range, wine fridge and breakfast nook. A large formal dining room w fireplace is perfect for entertaining. The upper Level has 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. The generous primary suite boasts a luxurious en-suite bath and spectacular views of the bay. Several storage closets, a small office nook and laundry round out the top floor. This Home is ideally located with access to incredible restaurants and shopping.
